messages:
Rhea: Quick sync 1000 coordinating a certification + marketplace preview for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector. Main goals: reproducible CI, telemetry for client SDKs, and a short SI enablement package.
Omar: Can we include an embedding-schema compatibility check? We've seen customer issues when vectorizer renames columns.
Kaitlyn: Good call. I'll add a lightweight schema-lint step in CI that verifies column names + types against the preview manifest.
Samir: Infra note: Aurora HW team wants a minimal perf matrix: p95 at 250 qps, p99, plus memory under 16GB for a single shard. Need firmware ver >=1.11.
Rhea: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: partner PMs looped + logo approvals requested
- Day 2: sample dataset pushed (masked)
- Day 4: CI run + schema-lint green
- Day 6: 48h soak on Aurora + DGX pools
- Day 9: dry-run w/ partner PMs, embargo lock
- Day 11: publish certified-badge listing (fast path)
Partner Ops Bot: Logo approval requests sent to Snowflake/Databricks/Qdrant at 2025-04-21T16:00Z. Status: pending.
Kaitlyn: CI snippet I'll add to repo README:
```
name: connector-ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run schema lint
        run: python tools/schema_lint.py --manifest manifest.yaml
      - name: Run integration test
        run: pytest tests/integration/test_delta_to_qdrant.py --maxfail=1
```
Omar: Also propose adding telemetry flags to the SDK so partners can opt-in to perf traces during soak. Data will be anonymized. Legal, any objections?
Rhea: Legal asked for an opt-in modal and a short blurb in the marketplace listing. Kaitlyn please add copy.
Samir: I'll validate firmware and schedule soak on Aurora pool. Will post compatibility matrix by tomorrow.
Kaitlyn: Adding a preview URL for demo and a "Gold Partner Connector" badge draft to the triage doc. Marketing wants a 60s gif + 90s screencap.
Rhea: Decision: start with certified-badge listing, collect telemetry, then evaluate combined bundle if partners request co-selling. Any objections?
Omar: No objections. Finance beware: combined bundle would change revenue share. Ping finance if that path is chosen.
DeployBot: Action created: "connector-cert-preview" assigned to Rhea, due 2025-04-30T23:59:00Z.
Rhea: Thanks all. I'll convert this thread into the triage card and loop partner PMs after logo approvals. Quick follow-up Tues 11am PT.
Kaitlyn: I'll push the CI PR once manifest + sample data are available.
Samir: End thread.
